frontier.next_probe: In the pointer-bump spelling, vary which field access is textually last in the loop body and read the 'dest address src reg NN ... add K' lines plus the 'giv at X combined with giv at Y' lines in the func_8007526C section of tmp/grind/func_8007526C/dumps/text1b.loop. A spelling whose last-registered address giv has add 0 keeps the target's pointer bump with no bias.
